component.name: Orbit
component.summary: Local-first, encrypted workspace for notes and diagrams

description.p: Orbit is a local-first, Obsidian-like workspace for markdown notes and Mermaid diagrams, kept as plain files in a folder. Selected folders can be protected with cryptographic encryption at rest.

ul.li: Markdown notes stored as plain files you own and control
Bidirectional links, backlinks, and tag navigation
Inline rendered Mermaid diagrams in pure Rust
Protected folders encrypted at rest with passphrase and recovery key
Instant full-text vault search and switcher
GPU-accelerated native interface with custom paper themes

description.p: Initial release of Orbit desktop application for Linux.
